$comment: PLACEHOLDER CONTENT. EVERY NUMBER IN THIS FILE IS A PLACEHOLDER PENDING GAME DESIGN.
Gameplay numbers are a human decision (design gate); these exist only so the Core v3
vertical slice can run end to end. Do not balance against them, do not quote them.
Content stats (ADR-30): the replicated stat block. id is permanent and starts at 1
(a proto3 zero is elided on the wire). key is lowercase letters, digits, underscores.
default is the value every actor (player, mob, npc, boss) spawns with.
The stat keyed 'level' is persisted as character_state.level (ADR-31).
